quotes.excerpt: I have been using an open source program “handy”, it is a cross platform rust tauri app that does speech recognition and handles inputting text into programs. It works by piggybacking off the OS’s text input or copy and paste features. You could fork this, and shell out to an LLM before finally pasting the response.
